## Defender Globe (CR 3)

**XP** 800  
 N Small outsider (elemental, native)  
 **Init** +3; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +8  

**Defense**

 **AC** 17, touch 17, flat-footed 13 (+2 deflection, +3 Dex, +1 dodge, +1 size)  
 **hp** 44 (4d10+4)  
 **Fort** +2; **Ref** +7; **Will** +5  
 **Defensive Abilities** awareness, defensive aura; **Immune** electricity; **Resist** cold 10, fire 10  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 5 ft., 40 ft. fly (perfect)  
 **Ranged** electrical bolt +9 (2d6 electricity)  
 **Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 4th)  

 Continuous—light  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 4, **Dex** 16, **Con** 12, **Int** 4, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 14  
 **Base Atk** +4; **CMB** +0; **CMD** 16 (can’t be tripped)  
 **Feats** [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), [Weapon Focus (bolt)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md)  
*House rules: Dodge and Mobility are one feat, Dodgility; in their place: Weapon Focus (bolt).*  
 **Skills** Fly +20, Knowledge (planes) +4, Perception +8  

**Special Abilities**

 **Awareness (Ex)** A defender globe cannot be surprised or flanked.  

 **Defensive Aura (Ex)** A defender globe adds its Charisma bonus to its AC and CMD as a deflection bonus.  

 **Flight (Su)** A defender globe can cease or resume flight as a free action. The ability is supernatural, so it becomes ineffective in an antimagic field, and the defender globe loses its ability to fly for as long as the antimagic effect persists.  

**Ecology**

**Environment** any  
 **Organization** solitary  
 **Treasure** incidental
